_comment: The approved evidence library security reviews are answered from. Each statement is owned by security, has a review date, and expires. Read by the questionnaire agent; the world uses the same ids as ground truth.

evidence.title: Encryption at rest
evidence.text: Customer content is encrypted at rest with AES-256; keys are managed in Azure Key Vault and rotated yearly. Customer-managed keys are available on enterprise plans.
evidence.keywords: encryption at rest aes 256 key management key vault rotation cmk byok verschlüsselung ruhezustand schlüssel

evidence.title: Encryption in transit
evidence.text: All traffic uses TLS 1.2 or higher; TLS 1.0 and 1.1 are disabled; HSTS is enforced.
evidence.keywords: encryption transit tls 1.2 1.3 https hsts übertragung transportverschlüsselung

evidence.title: Single sign-on
evidence.text: Customers sign in with their own identity provider over SAML 2.0 or OpenID Connect; Microsoft Entra ID, Okta and ADFS are supported. Password sign-in can be disabled.
evidence.keywords: single sign on sso saml oidc openid entra azure ad okta adfs identity provider anmeldung

evidence.title: User provisioning
evidence.text: Users and groups can be provisioned and deprovisioned automatically with SCIM 2.0; deprovisioned users lose access within minutes.
evidence.keywords: provisioning deprovisioning scim joiner leaver offboarding benutzerverwaltung

evidence.title: Multi-factor authentication
evidence.text: MFA is enforced through the customer's identity provider; for staff, phishing-resistant MFA is mandatory on all production access.
evidence.keywords: mfa multi factor two factor 2fa authentication zwei faktor

evidence.title: Data residency
evidence.text: Customer content is stored and processed in the region chosen at contract: EU (Sweden, Netherlands), Germany, UK, US or Australia. Backups stay in the same jurisdiction.
evidence.keywords: data residency location region eu germany uk where is data stored hosting datenstandort speicherort gespeichert deutschland rechenzentrum

evidence.title: Subprocessors
evidence.text: The current subprocessor list, with purpose and region for each, is published in the trust center; customers are notified 30 days before a new subprocessor is added.
evidence.keywords: subprocessors sub-processors third parties vendors list notification unterauftragsverarbeiter

evidence.title: No training on customer data
evidence.text: Customer content is never used to train models, ours or our model providers'. Model providers process content under zero-retention agreements.
evidence.keywords: training ai models customer data used to train zero retention model providers llm openai anthropic training kundendaten

evidence.title: Retention and deletion
evidence.text: Retention is configurable per workspace; on contract end all customer content is deleted within 30 days and deletion is confirmed in writing.
evidence.keywords: retention deletion delete data contract termination exit aufbewahrung aufbewahrt löschung gelöscht vertragsende

evidence.title: Document permissions
evidence.text: Documents from iManage, SharePoint and NetDocuments keep their source permissions, including ethical walls; each user can only find what the source system lets them read.
evidence.keywords: permissions access control ethical walls information barriers dms imanage sharepoint netdocuments matter security berechtigungen chinese wall

evidence.title: Role-based access
evidence.text: Admins assign roles per workspace; least privilege applies to staff, and production access is just-in-time and logged.
evidence.keywords: rbac role based access least privilege admin roles rollen zugriff

evidence.title: Audit logs
evidence.text: Every sign-in, query and document access is written to an audit log customers can export or stream to their SIEM for at least one year.
evidence.keywords: audit log logging siem monitoring export protokollierung

evidence.title: ISO 27001 certificate
evidence.text: The company holds an ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certificate covering the platform and its operations; the certificate is available in the trust center.
evidence.keywords: iso 27001 certification isms certificate zertifizierung

evidence.title: SOC 2 Type II report
evidence.text: A SOC 2 Type II report covering security, availability and confidentiality is issued yearly and shared under NDA.
evidence.keywords: soc 2 soc2 type ii audit report attestation

evidence.title: Penetration test 2025
evidence.text: An independent penetration test of the platform was completed in March 2025; no critical findings remain open.
evidence.keywords: penetration test pentest third party security testing red team penetrationstest

evidence.title: Penetration test 2026
evidence.text: An independent penetration test of the platform and the Word add-in was completed in April 2026; all high findings were fixed within 30 days and a summary letter is available.
evidence.keywords: penetration test pentest third party security testing red team penetrationstest

evidence.title: Vulnerability management
evidence.text: Dependencies and images are scanned on every build; critical vulnerabilities are fixed within 7 days and high within 30.
evidence.keywords: vulnerability management scanning patching cve sla schwachstellen

evidence.title: Incident response
evidence.text: A documented incident response plan is tested twice a year; customers are notified of a personal data breach without undue delay and within 48 hours.
evidence.keywords: incident response breach notification gdpr 72 hours security incident sicherheitsvorfall meldung

evidence.title: Business continuity
evidence.text: The platform runs across availability zones; RPO is 1 hour and RTO is 4 hours, and disaster recovery is tested yearly.
evidence.keywords: business continuity disaster recovery bcp dr rpo rto availability backup notfall

evidence.title: Data processing agreement
evidence.text: A GDPR Article 28 data processing agreement with the EU Standard Contractual Clauses is part of every contract.
evidence.keywords: dpa data processing agreement gdpr article 28 scc standard contractual clauses avv auftragsverarbeitung dsgvo

evidence.title: Personnel security
evidence.text: Staff pass background checks where local law allows, sign confidentiality agreements and complete security training every year.
evidence.keywords: background checks employees personnel screening confidentiality training mitarbeiter

evidence.title: AI governance
evidence.text: Model changes are evaluated against legal benchmarks before release, outputs cite their sources, and customers can switch features off per workspace.
evidence.keywords: ai governance model risk evaluation hallucination accuracy eu ai act ki governance
